hardware.gpu_hour_definition: One allocated GPU for one hour; four-GPU node hour costs four GPU-hours.
hardware.throughput_authority: Measured exact-shape end-to-end throughput, with startup, data, checkpoints and evaluation charged once.

phases.name: Pre-access data and design readiness
phases.exit_gate: Before R0: bounded legal synthetic/retained qualification inputs, storage, job/accounting limits and recovery commands prepared. Production corpus need not exist for bounded hardware tests; R1/R2 require their own verified data.

phases.name: Exact-shape GH200, DDP, checkpoint and evaluation qualification
phases.exit_gate: Exact 1.2B 4K/32K/128K feasibility recorded; full forward/backward and save/resume, kernels, DDP, storage and end-to-end throughput measured. 128K failure chooses length fallback; unsafe baseline runtime blocks training.

phases.name: Bounded base recipe/repetition, task difficulty and endpoint calibration
phases.exit_gate: Freeze complete R2/R3 cost sheets, independent pilots, numerical quality margins/floors, data partitions, primary scoring and endpoints before confirmation. Qualify broad corpus repetition/capacity without old mixture search.

phases.name: Three-seed architecture by supervision study
phases.exit_gate: All planned cells and failures retained; no quality-dependent seed replacement or post-hoc recipe rescue.

phases.name: One preselected scale or horizon transfer check
phases.exit_gate: Preselected transfer route completed or failure explicitly narrows claims; no favorable route switching.

phases.name: Core/transfer evaluation, analysis and recipe decision
phases.exit_gate: All paired effects, uncertainty and guardrails analyzed; standard or targeted recipe chosen from development only.

phases.name: Qualified production-data and flagship launch freeze
phases.exit_gate: Full source capacity and per-source exposures, actual data delivery, immutable training manifest, tokenizer, checkpoints, token target and remaining calendar/budget pass; data launch receipt requalified for new partitions.

phases.name: 1.2B broad base pretraining
phases.exit_gate: Finite pre-decay and base checkpoint retained with costs and capability/loss curves; final target selected before launch.

phases.name: Context and instruction capability development
phases.exit_gate: Broad instruction model at its measured useful length; null targeted results use standard recipe; earlier qualified checkpoint retained on regression.

phases.name: Final quality and public/retrieval comparator evaluation
phases.exit_gate: Frozen final suite and public/RAG comparisons complete with uncertainty and missing-result disclosure; final sealed audit opened only once.

phases.name: Measured systems and accelerated serving
phases.exit_gate: Named-hardware quality-cost points measured, with state, peak memory, prefill, decode, total task time and output cost separate.

phases.name: Export parity, reproducibility and two demonstrations
phases.exit_gate: Qualified inference/export parity, reproducible commands and held-out demos; unsupported backends removed from release claims.

phases.name: Protected recovery reserve
phases.exit_gate: Each use recorded against existing failure or recovery trigger; no new axis and no automatic entitlement to spend.

phases.name: Paper and release package
phases.exit_gate: Manuscript regenerated from checked results, independent review recorded, artifacts and technical opportunity brief prepared; external outreach/publication needs its own requested action.

included: paper plus usable model and reproducible artifacts

calendar_policy: Ranges are targets and may overlap for independent work only. Dependencies dominate dates; one node cannot run B0 and other GPU work concurrently. Reforecast remaining node-days and storage readiness after every gate. Day-21 is an aim, not permission to skip readiness.

base_horizon_policy.freeze: Choose 400B only if measured forecast fits B0 and calendar without borrowing from capability, evaluation or reserve; otherwise choose 320B. If 320B does not fit, stop before launch for a costed successor rather than silently spending reserve or training an undisclosed horizon.
base_horizon_policy.unused_hours: Retain as headroom; a phase-local extension requires pre-results endpoint and cost amendment. Do not change scientific endpoints based on results.

reserve_order: repair an existing capability stage under its frozen trigger
replicate a declared consequential result if all required artifacts are secure
continue retained flagship only after required artifacts are secure
cut_order: 128K target to qualified 64K/32K under length fallback
protected: three complete paired R2 seed blocks while retaining confirmatory inference
889-hour reserve unless released by recorded trigger
